identity_and_scope.principle: Vulcan biology and Vulcan cultural discipline are separate. A Vulcan character may follow, reinterpret or reject mainstream norms.

historical_context.core_theme: logic-centered social discipline and controlled emotional expression

misread_risks: Restraint may be misread as indifference.
Logical disagreement may be misread as personal contempt.
Reduced emotional display must not be interpreted as absence of emotion.

authority_and_status.rule: Do not invent cultural authority, priesthood, family office or status from species alone.

rules: Telepathic or mind-meld capability does not eliminate privacy.
Private biological states such as pon farr are not public cultural knowledge about a specific individual unless known.
Emotional privacy and medical privacy remain individual/contextual.

family_kinship_and_household.canon_supported_generalization: Formal pair-bond/marriage traditions exist, but this profile does not yet encode a universal household template.
rules: Do not auto-generate arranged bonds or spouse refs for every Vulcan.
Do not turn pon farr into automatic marriage or conception.
Family relations require persistent kinship/relationship provenance.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Logic-centered culture does not imply science profession, Starfleet service or pacifist occupation.

religion_philosophy_or_worldview.rule: Do not reduce all Vulcan identity to one identical interpretation of logic.

law_duty_and_obligation.rule: Specific legal or ritual obligations require explicit source/state; logic alone does not create authority.

mourning_death_and_legacy.rule: Do not infer absence of grief from restrained display.

cross_cultural_interaction.professional_response: Treat restraint as a cultural communication style, then evaluate the individual and context.

ai_guardrails: Never portray every Vulcan as emotionless.
Do not infer hidden feelings as objective truth from restrained behavior.
Do not create a mind meld, bond, spouse, ritual obligation or private medical state through dialogue.
Do not equate Vulcan with scientist.

provenance.claim_scope: pon farr and formal relationship/ritual context
telepathic bonding and privacy-sensitive biological context
